Extracts favicon link tags including apple-touch-icon

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(nil)
url = 'https://example.com'
result = Crawlberg.scrape(engine, url)
puts result.status_code.inspect
puts result.metadata.favicons.length.inspect
puts result.metadata.favicons[0].rel.inspect
```
